description: This file defines the OrganizationsRepository class, which extends OrganizationRepository and provides methods for managing organization data, billing relations, and user associations in a Prisma-based database, integrating with Stripe for billing.

classes.name: OrganizationsRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing organization data, billing, and user associations, extending OrganizationRepository.

methods.name: findByIds
methods.description: Finds multiple organizations by their IDs.

methods.name: findByIdIncludeBilling
methods.description: Finds an organization by ID including billing info.

methods.name: createNewBillingRelation
methods.description: Creates a new billing relation for an organization using Stripe and updates the database.

methods.name: findTeamIdAndSlugFromClientId
methods.description: Retrieves team ID and slug based on OAuth client ID.

methods.name: findPlatformOrgFromUserId
methods.description: Finds platform organization info from a user ID.

methods.name: findOrgUser
methods.description: Finds a user within an organization.

methods.name: findOrgTeamUser
methods.description: Finds a user within an organization and team.

methods.name: fetchOrgAdminApiStatus
methods.description: Fetches API admin status for an organization.

methods.name: findOrgBySlug
methods.description: Finds an organization by its slug.

methods.name: findTeamByPlatformBillingId
methods.description: Finds a team by its platform billing ID.
